subject: How do I change my display name?
issue: I want to update my display name on my HackerRank profile but can't find the option.
response: To change your display name, log in to HackerRank, click your profile picture in the top right, go to Profile, then click Edit Profile. Update your Name field and click Save Changes. Note that your username used in URLs cannot be changed after account creation.
justification: Standard self-serve account settings question answered from candidate account documentation.

subject: Forgot password and can't get back in
issue: I forgot my Claude password and can't log in. Please help me reset it.
response: To reset your Claude password, go to claude.ai/login and click Forgot password. Enter your registered email address, then check your inbox for a reset link which expires in 30 minutes. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.
justification: Straightforward password reset request answered from account documentation.

subject: My solution gives wrong answer but works locally
issue: My Python solution passes all sample test cases but gets wrong answer on hidden ones. I have tested it with many inputs and it seems correct.
response: Hidden test cases often test edge cases not shown in the samples. Common issues include: off-by-one errors, not handling empty input or single-element arrays, integer overflow for large inputs, or trailing spaces in output. Re-read the problem constraints carefully and test your solution against extreme values.
justification: Standard debugging guidance for hidden test case failures from assessments documentation.

subject: How do I report my lost card?
issue: I cannot find my Visa card and I am worried it might have been stolen. What steps should I take?
response: Report your lost or stolen card immediately to prevent unauthorized use. Call the 24/7 number on the back of your card or use your card issuer's mobile app — go to Cards, select your card, and choose Report Lost or Stolen. This blocks the card immediately. A replacement card will be mailed within 5–7 business days. Visa's Zero Liability Policy protects you from unauthorized charges when reported promptly.
justification: Standard lost card reporting procedure answered from lost-or-stolen documentation.

subject: How do I cancel my Claude Pro subscription?
issue: I want to cancel my Claude Pro subscription. Can you tell me how to do that and whether I get a refund?
response: To cancel your Claude Pro subscription, go to Settings, then Billing, and click Cancel subscription. Your Pro features will remain active until the end of your current billing period. Note that no refunds are issued for partial months.
justification: Subscription cancellation process and refund policy answered from billing documentation.

subject: Can I use my Visa card in Europe?
issue: I am traveling to France next month and want to know if my Visa card will work there and if there are extra fees.
response: Visa cards are accepted in 200+ countries including France. To avoid having your card declined, notify your bank before you travel by adding a Travel Notice in your online banking or mobile app. Your card may have a foreign transaction fee of 1%–3% — check your cardholder agreement. When paying at merchants, always choose to pay in the local currency (euros) rather than your home currency to avoid poor Dynamic Currency Conversion rates.
justification: International card usage guidance answered from travel and international transactions documentation.

subject: My IDE is frozen during the test
issue: The in-browser IDE stopped responding 20 minutes into my coding test. I cannot type or submit. Help urgently.
response: If the IDE freezes, do NOT close the tab as this may affect your attempt. Wait 30 seconds for it to recover. If still frozen, hard-refresh the page using Ctrl+Shift+R (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+Shift+R (Mac) — your saved code will be restored. The IDE auto-saves every 30 seconds when online. If you lost significant progress due to the issue, document it and contact the recruiting company directly for a manual review.
justification: IDE freeze troubleshooting steps from coding environment documentation.

subject: How do I change my PIN?
issue: I want to change my Visa card PIN. I know my current PIN but want to update it to something easier to remember.
response: You can change your PIN at any Visa-affiliated ATM: insert your card, enter your current PIN, then select PIN Change from the menu and enter your new PIN. Many issuers also allow PIN changes through their mobile app under Card Settings, through online banking, or by calling the number on the back of your card.
justification: Standard PIN change procedure answered from PIN management documentation.

subject: How many messages can I send per day on the free plan?
issue: I am on the free plan and want to know exactly how many messages I can send before I hit the daily limit.
response: On the free plan, the exact number of messages per day is not fixed — it varies based on message length, the model used, and current platform demand. When you reach your limit, you will see a message saying you have reached your daily limit, which resets after 24 hours. Upgrading to Claude Pro provides approximately 5 times more messages than the free plan.
justification: Usage limits for the free plan explained from billing and usage limits documentation.
